questions.q: It was ___ a nice day that we went out.
She is ___ tired that she can't walk.
They are ___ kind people!
The film was ___ boring that I fell asleep.
He's ___ good player!
It was ___ hot that we stayed inside.

questions.explanation: The pattern is 'such a' + adjective + singular noun.
options: She is so a kind woman.
She is such a kind woman.
She is such a kind women.
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
The soup is ___ salty. I can't eat it.

questions.explanation: Use 'such a' before a singular countable noun.
questions.q: He told ___ funny story!
They were ___ happy to see us!
It was ___ interesting book that I read it twice.
She speaks ___ quickly that I can't understand.

questions.explanation: Before adjective + plural noun use 'such', not 'so': 'such kind people'.
options: She is such a nice girl.
questions.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
The test was ___ difficult that nobody passed.

questions.explanation: Use 'such an' before a vowel sound + singular noun.
questions.q: He's ___ honest man.
We had ___ wonderful time!
I'm ___ hungry. Let's eat!
It was ___ expensive restaurant.
The music was ___ loud that my ears hurt.
She's ___ talented singer!
